_source.title: 生成指示标记
_source.remarks.text.0: 指示标记外形数据中，原理图、符号画布坐标单位跨度为 0.01inch，PCB、封装画布坐标单位跨度为 mil
_source.params.markers: 指示标记外形对象数组
_source.params.tabId: 标签页 ID，如若未传入，则为最后输入焦点的画布
_source.returns: 指示标记生成是否成功，`false` 表示画布不支持该操作或 `tabId` 不存在

title: Generate indicator markers
remarks.text.0: In the indicator marker shape data, the coordinate unit span of the schematic and symbol canvases is 0.01inch, and that of the PCB and footprint canvases is mil
params.markers: Array of indicator marker shape objects
params.tabId: Tab ID. If not passed in, the canvas with the last input focus will be used
returns: Whether the indicator markers were generated successfully, `false` indicates that the canvas does not support this operation or `tabId` does not exist
